assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: original toy catalog photograph for Playfield visual design storybook. Create one square overhead studio photograph of a fictional wooden mosaic art kit on a warm ivory background. A shallow natural birch rectangular tray sits beside EXACTLY twelve loose thick wooden square tiles arranged as a clean 3 by 4 grid. Tile colors: muted forest green, mustard, dusty coral, pale blue, warm cream; each tile has simple contrasting half-circle or quarter-circle geometric motifs, no letters. Two small rectangular printed idea cards show only abstract geometric patterns and are set beside the tray. Whole tray, all twelve individual tiles and both cards fully visible with generous clear margin; physically plausible tactile wood, softly rounded edges, neat composition, warm diffuse daylight and subtle shadows, premium realistic product photography. The loose tiles, tray and two idea cards are the only kit contents. No packaging, no people, no tools, no text, no logos, no watermark, no UI. Product is a fictional 12-tile kit; do not imply safety certification. Keep objects separated, countable, and uncropped.
assets.limitations: Synthetic product; photo is not evidence of dimensions, materials, age suitability or certification.

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original wide editorial toy activity photograph for Playfield responsive design mockups. The referenced image is a PRODUCT AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve the fictional kit's twelve geometric wooden tiles in forest green, mustard, dusty coral, pale blue and warm cream, natural birch rectangular tray, and two idea cards. Create a new landscape 3:2 photo from a comfortable oblique overhead angle on a pale oak activity table. All twelve tiles loosely form a pleasing colorful garden-like geometric mosaic in the tray. The two idea cards sit beside it. A single adult brown-skinned hand reaches gently toward a tile, visibly an adult hand, realistic anatomy, as a scale cue. Whole kit fully visible with generous table margin, natural grain and tactile painted wood, warm indirect daylight, quiet and inviting, editorial catalog quality. No children, no extra toys, no packaging, no letters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no website/UI. Do not add safety claims. Image should support a buyer understanding the physical activity, not a decorative abstract render.
assets.role: Activity context with an adult hand, product reference from asset 1
assets.limitations: Synthetic product; photo is not evidence of dimensions, materials, age suitability or certification.
